svg.aria-label: Fit on the earlier draft classes, scored on the later ones
svg.title: Fit on the earlier draft classes, scored on the later ones
svg.text: Every modeled draftee, one dot, in his draft class
2,000+ NBA minutes in his first three seasons
A random split would scatter test players across all 12 classes, so the model would
be scored on the same eras it was fit on. Holding out whole classes asks the
question a front office faces: will a model fit on past drafts rank the next ones?
